notes: Audio & GIF support, redesigned update dialog. See What's new.

whats_new.title: Audio & GIF support
items: Audio files (.mp3, .wav, .flac, .m4a, .aac, .ogg, .opus, .wma, .aiff) now organize into an Audio/ folder by date
GIFs get their own GIFs/ folder instead of being mixed in with photos
Two new toggles: Include audio files, Include GIFs (both on by default)

whats_new.title: One-click auto-update
items: Download & install updates directly from the app — no more hunting through your Gumroad library
Downloads are SHA-256 verified before they run
Redesigned update dialog with full What's new and Skip this version

whats_new.title: Quality of life
items: Keep original filenames — sort into date folders without renaming
Organize inside the source folder (no separate destination needed)
Smart default destination when you add your first source
Window auto-fits your screen; fixed size (no more resize jank)

whats_new.title: Fixes
items: Installer no longer leaves two copies when updating from 1.0.0
